custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate assets are held in on-chain vault and lender-position contracts, but the sole funded lending market uses custodial WBTC collateral. WBTC's official FAQ requires authorized custodians to hold and release BTC. This material downstream custody layer prevents an exclusively on-chain whole-book label; the reviewed model is mixed. Parent RLUSD reserve custody is inherited separately. No exact-share legal insolvency priority, borrower-collateral segregation or funded recovery guarantee is established. Lending reuse is explicit. Contract deployment on Ethereum is not a legal jurisdiction. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
